briefs: {port} is running short of {cargo}. Bring {units} units there by run {deadline}; you are paid for the goods and the trouble.
The quartermaster at {port} needs {units} units of {cargo} before run {deadline}. Buy them wherever they are cheap and deliver them there.
A raider band of {ships} ships preys on shipping in {system}. Destroy it before run {deadline}.
Traders out of {port} have stopped flying to {system}: a band of {ships} raiders waits there. Wipe it out by run {deadline}.
The {trader} is bound for {port} and fears raiders on the way. Have a fleet in {system} when it docks there, before run {deadline}.
Its owners pay well to see the {trader} safely into {port}. Be in {system} when it arrives, by run {deadline}.
The port authority wants fresh sensor readings of {body}. Put a ship in orbit there by run {deadline}.
Charts of {body} are out of date. Fly there and orbit or land on it before run {deadline}.
A fence at {port} buys whatever falls off a trader's hold. Seize {units} units from traders, by demand or plunder, before run {deadline}.
Nobody at {port} asks where cargo comes from. Take {units} units from passing traders by run {deadline} and the fence pays for the trouble.
A buyer at {port} wants {units} {cargo} that never passed a {faction} customs office. Deliver them by run {deadline}; if their police stop you on the way, the deal is off.
Carry {units} {cargo} into {faction} space and hand them over at {port} by run {deadline}. Stay clear of their patrols: one inspection and the buyer vanishes.
